comment: Hand-curated map from legacy Beekeeper (bkpr-*) and kebab-case LumX (lx-*) tags to the LumX component that replaces them. The generator validates every `to` against the parsed component list and fails on an unknown name. `confidence: confirmed` means the replacement has been used in a real migration; `suggested` means it still needs a human to check the details.

migrations.note: Pass the icon path from @lumx/icons, e.g. `<Icon :icon="mdiPhone" />`. Never inline a raw SVG path.
Replaces a `<button>` wrapping an icon. `label` is required (it also becomes the tooltip). Always pass `emphasis` and `theme`, otherwise the button renders with no background.
Use `emphasis="high"` for the single main action of a view, `medium` for secondary actions, `low` for tertiary ones.
AlertDialog for a confirm/alert flow; Dialog for anything with custom content.
Vue has no Dropdown component. Use MenuButton for a button that opens a menu, or Popover plus List for a custom anchored panel.
ProgressCircular for a spinner, ProgressLinear for a bar.
Split into InputLabel, InputHelper and InputRequiredLegend around the field itself.
Tabs are built from TabProvider + TabList + Tab + TabPanel.
LumX has no floating action button. Use IconButton with `emphasis="high"` and position it yourself.
No LumX equivalent. Keep the Beekeeper component or use a plain image.

patterns.note: Replaces the whole button. `<IconButton label="Add" emphasis="medium" :icon="mdiPlus" :theme="theme" />`

patterns.from: raw SVG path in an icon prop
patterns.note: Import the named path from @lumx/icons instead: `import { mdiPhone } from '@lumx/icons'`. Use search_icons to find the name.

patterns.from: hardcoded colour or spacing value in SCSS
patterns.note: Use a LumX CSS custom property, e.g. `var(--lumx-color-dark-N)` or `var(--lumx-spacing-unit-big)`. Use search_design_tokens to find it.
